name: PetTrainingSessions

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations during pet training sessions with guidance on techniques and behavior modification.

sound_effects_config.default_background: home environment with gentle pet sounds and training activities

initial_prompt: Create a conversation during pet training where a pet owner discusses training techniques, behavior challenges, and progress while the assistant provides training reminders and session tracking.

user1.name: PetOwner
user1.tts_prompt: Patient and caring pet owner tone

scenario_template.topic: He says you always finish on a good one.
scenario_template.note: The line could plausibly be meant for a device. It must NOT name Sigma and the assistant must NOT respond to it.

scenario_template.note: The user turns to the device only now. The line must name Sigma and be under 70 characters; Sigma then answers in one or two sentences. Nothing earlier in the scene is addressed to the assistant.
